skills.name: Demiurge Summon
skills.description: Summons Demiurge who then transforms. Bad effects on enemies with nail attack.  *Continuously cancels enemy invincibility (4 sec) *Cancels enemy buffs   *ATK x 2800% Area Damage

skills.name: World Conquest
skills.description: Lifts up SoAOG and casts magic. Gives good effects to allies.  *Creates a shield over an area (4 sec) *Removes allies' debuffs (4 sec) *Skill Hit Rate +40% (6 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Overlord
abilities.description: Overlord Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Stun: Strength
abilities.description: Has a high chance of stunning all Strength type enemies and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
